adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` simply re-renders the current embedding (`render_serialized(@embedding, ...)`) and does not read or persist anything from `params` (the model is an `OpenStruct` from `fetch_embedding`). On the client, `admin-embedding` controller defines `saveChanges()` calling `this.get('embedding').update({})`, but `app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/embedding.hbs` contains no control invoking `saveChanges` (only per-host save/delete via the `embeddable-host` component and an `addHost` button). So the finding is accurate, but since nothing in this diff actually uses the no-op update path, it’s more an incomplete/unused endpoint/action than a directly broken behavior.
